messages:
jordan: Quick sync — proposing a small experiment: stochastic per-batch precision switching (FP8 / INT8 / 4-bit) to probe quality degradation vs KV-cache pressure and batching behavior. Thoughts? cc @maria @kevin

maria: curious — how do you envision toggling? per-batch random sampling or heuristic-driven (kv-miss, prompt-length)?

jordan: per-batch random sampling to start (5% sample) so we can get unbiased signal. later add heuristics. runtime should tag a sample id and precision variant for telemetry.

kevin: main risks: distribution shift in late tokens, and cache incompatibility when switching precision mid-conversation. we need a clear rollback trigger (degscore or quality delta).

lee: agree on rollback triggers. also watch latency tail — some kernels for 4-bit have worse p95 when batch size varies. we should record : latency.p50,p95,p99 per-variant.

jordan: proposed minimal API: add optional header `X-Precision-Experiment: stochastic` and body field `precision_sample_rate` for canary. runtime maps to variant via seed. example config:```
precision_experiment: stochastic
variants: ["fp8","int8","4bit"]
sample_rate: 0.05
seed_policy: runtime_ts % 1000
fallback_rule: "deg_delta>0.15 or latency.p95>200ms"
```

maria: love the header approach — keeps model catalog unchanged. but ops needs deterministic mapping for debugging (trace->variant). include `precision.variant` and `sample.id` in traces.

kevin: telemetry needs: `precision.variant`, `sample.id`, `deg_before`, `deg_after`, `deg_delta`, `kv_miss_rate`, `batch_size`, `seq_len`, `latency.*`, `tokens_generated`. also collect a shadowed ground-truth run (no precision change) for a subset so we can compute real quality delta.

lee: about interface boundaries — runtime should implement the sampling and fallback, catalog should host approved fallback profiles (e.g., quantized compatible weights). avoid adding per-model schema changes. runtime config + an ops toggle is enough.

jordan: rollout plan: 1) local sim harness (QA) 2) shadow sampling at 1% for 24h 3) live canary 5% on low-traffic endpoint 4) expand and add heuristic gating. add an ops playbook for immediate forced-unflag.

maria: also add an automated regression alert: if mean deg_delta > 0.08 across sampled requests or any customer facing API shows >0.12, auto-disable experiment and page eng-ml.

kevin: one more: KV cache compatibility — if we stage variants that change kv serialization, we must pin variant per-conversation and never mutate existing cached keys. runtime must ensure variant-stability for a conversation, and if new variant incompatible, mark as new conversation or skip sampling.

jordan: yep. plan: sampling only at request start when there's no cached state for that conv. otherwise skip sampling. document that in runtime API.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary rollout (eng-ml-canary) with header flag `stochastic` at 15:00 PST. Monitor metrics `precision.variant`, `deg_delta`, `latency.p95` for first 30 minutes. :rocket:

lee: action items: @kevin add telemetry schema, @maria write QA harness steps, @jordan draft runtime flag + header docs, @ops-bot please only deploy after QA signoff.

jordan: thanks all — I'll open the RFC-followup doc and attach the sim results once we have them.
